in_hebrew.name: Meghann
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, brave one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Meghann הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish name Máebh, meaning ‘intensely powerful’, or ‘mighty one’. In Irish mythology, Máebh was a goddess associated with sovereignty and fertility. Meghann could also be derived from the Greek name Megas, meaning ‘great’, or ‘large’.
